scenarios.name: 2-workers-32KiB

load.mix: 90% GET /documents/:id, 10% CAS PUT; one independent document per worker

database_settings_evidence.admission_capacity_basis: Database implementation admits max_connections * 2; not an independently sampled runtime counter.

limitations: The old baseline explicitly records uncontrolled background host load. Differences are descriptive observations, not causal speedup claims or SLO evidence.
There is no matching before measurement for the 8-worker 2MiB scenario.
Successful-request latency excludes failed requests; inspect error rate and both attempted/successful throughput together.
Cold overlap sample counts differ; p99 with 30 or 31 samples is essentially the observed maximum.
RSS is sampled process resident memory, not allocator usage or a guaranteed OS high-water mark.
